script_text: Aries, this week your Mars-ruled fire gets redirected from drama into a doorway: what you claim at home becomes leverage. Monday and Tuesday are charged: Mars, your ruler, squares Pluto in your 11th House, exposing power games in friendships, while Sun in Gemini squares Neptune in your 12th House, so contracts and texts need double-checking. Monday is worst for confrontations. Wednesday brings the pivot: Saturn retrograde re-enters Aquarius and your 11th; Mars enters Cancer Thursday, activating your 4th House, turning strategy into support. Friday is your power day because Venus enters Leo and your 5th House, trining Uranus in your 2nd House, so romance or career pitches can trigger money. Saturday's Venus-square-Saturn asks lovers and friends to pause. Sunday's late Virgo Moon in your 6th House trines Uranus in your 2nd House, smoothing money choices. Keep one offer written before signing. Follow for daily updates.
